text: What fit_error_vs_true_law does the exact vis-viva expression a^2/r - a/2 get against a^3/r^2 on the e in [0, 0.7], m2 = 0.5 data? If it is below 0.2, the law-recovery criterion cannot separate r^-1 from r^-2 on this distribution, and E3 fits need a stricter criterion or a higher eccentricity range.
